2025

Bench: Prem Narayan Singh
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Ind:17564
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Prem Narayan Singh
 On The 10th Of July, 2025
 Misc. Petition No. 718 of 2025
 Icici Lombard General Insurance Co.Ltd
 Versus
 Vantri And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Kunal Jain - learned counsel for the petitioner.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Order 
1. This miscellaneous petition has been preferred by the petitioner under Article 227 of the Constitution of India being aggrieved by the order dated 17.05.2024 passed in M.A.C.C. No.64/2024 by the learned Ist Member, MACT, District Alirajpur (MP), whereby the claim of respondents/claimants has been entertained despite not filing within six months of occurrence of the incident.

2. In a nutshell, the facts in brief are that a claim for compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act,
1988 was filed on 11.09.2023 regarding the injuries occurred in motor vehicles accident dated 16.12.2022 alleging the application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963.
3. Counsel for the petitioner submits that issue of limitation is under consideration before Hon'ble Apex Court for adjudication in SLP (C) No.9152/2023.

Therefore, Tribunal be directed not to pass final order NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:17564 2 MP-718-2025 in MACC No.64/2024.
4.
I have heard counsel for the parties and have perused the record.

5. In view of submission of counsel for the petitioner, it is directed that Tribunal shall proceed with the case, but it shall not pass final order in the case, till disposal of the issue of limitation before the Icici Lombard General Insurance Co.Ltd vs Vantri on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107517757/
1
